source_precedence_checks: Used Law over Playbook/ordinary aids, except the Site Reference; applied supplied errata.
Confirmed random later-setup Reliquary placement, exact Citizen Supply-marker refresh, no-adviser Darkest Secret vulnerability and empty/ruin-only protection.
Confirmed end-of-Campaign Supremacy transfer, local co-located relic target, defensive side sharing with individual board/site meanings and defender arbitration.

Confirmed fixed Travel-cost changes before other modifiers, no-Supply override, adviser new-limit check, faceup-only rule, no cards at facedown sites, corrected Draw, removed You entry and bandit enemy status.
Confirmed Chronicle other-Exile offers, retained ruled-ruin denizens and 10-denizen+2-Vision top stack.
Q031 current key correctly permits a co-located non-enemy target; the enemy wording in one illustrative subquestion does not restrict the main theft rule.

Q096–Q100 explicitly test positive Rule, Reveal/Peek/Play, After, default Take/Give/Burn locations and optional Exchange; these were reviewed as generic operations rather than assumed from named examples.
